column1: # grade-term-unit | source sentence | Chinese translation | phrase=translation;phrase=translation | original reading | translation of original reading

3-upper-1|We listen with care and help each other.|我们认真倾听，互相帮助。|make friends=交朋友;help each other=互相帮助|This is my friend. We read and play together. We help each other at school.|这是我的朋友。我们一起读书、玩耍。我们在学校互相帮助。
3-upper-2|I have two cousins too.|我也有两个堂（表）兄弟姐妹。|my family=我的家人;play with me=和我一起玩|This is my family. I have a little sister. We love each other.|这是我的家庭。我有一个妹妹。我们彼此相爱。
3-upper-3|This is a monkey.|这是一只猴子。|a cute cat=一只可爱的猫;like animals=喜欢动物|I have a dog. It is small and cute. I give it water every day.|我有一只狗。它又小又可爱。我每天给它水喝。
3-upper-4|I like the fresh air.|我喜欢新鲜的空气。|fresh air=新鲜空气;plant trees=种树|This is our garden. The trees are green. We give the flowers water.|这是我们的花园。树是绿色的。我们给花浇水。
3-upper-5|What colour is it？|它是什么颜色？|red and blue=红色和蓝色;draw a bird=画一只鸟|I have a blue bag. My friend has a yellow bag. We like different colours.|我有一个蓝色的书包。我的朋友有一个黄色的书包。我们喜欢不同的颜色。
3-upper-6|How old are you？|你几岁了？|five years old=五岁;happy birthday=生日快乐|I am eight years old. I have six books and two pens. I can count from one to ten.|我八岁了。我有六本书和两支钢笔。我会从一数到十。
3-lower-1|We are friends.|我们是朋友。|new friends=新朋友;my neighbour=我的邻居|Hello! My name is Amy. This is my new neighbour. We say hello every morning.|你好！我叫埃米。这是我的新邻居。我们每天早上互相问好。
3-lower-2|We express ourselves in many ways.|我们用许多方式表达自己。|a big smile=灿烂的笑容;feel happy=感到高兴|I feel happy today. I smile and sing a song. My friend smiles too.|我今天很高兴。我微笑着唱了一首歌。我的朋友也笑了。
3-lower-3|I smell with my nose.|我用鼻子闻气味。|use a ruler=使用尺子;read a book=读一本书|I use my eyes to look. I use my ears to listen. I ask questions in class.|我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我在课堂上提问。

3-lower-4|This is my healthy plate.|这是我的健康餐盘。|healthy food=健康食物;fruit and vegetables=水果和蔬菜|I eat rice and vegetables for lunch. I drink some water. An apple is my favourite fruit.|我午餐吃米饭和蔬菜。我喝一些水。苹果是我最喜欢的水果。
3-lower-5|I have some old cars and boats.|我有一些旧的玩具汽车和玩具船。|old toys=旧玩具;share toys=分享玩具|I have an old toy car. It still works well. I give it to my little brother.|我有一辆旧玩具汽车。它仍然能正常行驶。我把它送给弟弟。
3-lower-6|We have fifteen books.|我们有十五本书。|fifteen books=十五本书;count the toys=数一数玩具|There are twelve crayons in the box. I give two to my friend. Now I have ten crayons.|盒子里有十二支蜡笔。我给朋友两支。现在我有十支蜡笔。
4-upper-1|I look after my sister.|我照顾我的妹妹。|sweep the floor=扫地;make the bed=整理床铺|I help at home every day. I make my bed in the morning. After dinner, I clean the table.|我每天在家帮忙。早上我整理床铺。晚饭后我擦桌子。
4-upper-2|My friends are special.|我的朋友们很特别。|good friends=好朋友;play together=一起玩|My friend is quiet and kind. She likes reading. I like sport, but we have fun together.|我的朋友文静又友善。她喜欢阅读。我喜欢运动，但我们在一起很快乐。

4-upper-3|We all make our community！|我们共同建设自己的社区！|near the park=在公园附近;go to the hospital=去医院|There is a park near my home. A library is next to it. I read there on Sundays.|我家附近有一个公园。公园旁边有一座图书馆。我星期天在那里读书。
4-upper-4|She is making the bed.|她正在整理床铺。|take photos=拍照;help others=帮助别人|We help in our community. I pick up litter in the park. My friend waters the flowers.|我们在社区里帮忙。我在公园里捡垃圾。我的朋友给花浇水。

4-upper-5|I stay at home and I wait.|我待在家里等候。|make a snowman=堆雪人;stay at home=待在家里|It is rainy today. I take an umbrella to school. Tomorrow will be sunny, and I can play outside.|今天下雨。我带着雨伞去上学。明天会是晴天，我就可以去外面玩了。
4-upper-6|The pink socks are mine.|粉色的袜子是我的。|in winter=在冬天;put on a coat=穿上外套|It is cold in winter. I wear a warm coat and gloves. In summer, I wear a T-shirt.|冬天很冷。我穿暖和的外套，戴手套。夏天我穿T恤衫。

4-lower-1|We listen, ask and answer.|我们倾听、提问并回答。|follow the rules=遵守规则;keep quiet=保持安静|We have rules in our classroom. We listen when others speak. We put our hands up to ask questions.|我们的教室里有规则。别人说话时我们认真听。提问时我们举手。

4-lower-2|There are rules at school and at home.|学校和家里都有规则。|family rules=家庭规则;be safe=注意安全|At home, I put my toys away. I finish my homework before playing games. These rules help me.|在家里，我把玩具收好。我做完作业再玩游戏。这些规则对我有帮助。
4-lower-3|It's time to get up！|该起床了！|get up=起床;go to school=去上学|I get up at seven. I have breakfast with my family. At eight, I go to school.|我七点起床。我和家人一起吃早饭。八点钟我去上学。
4-lower-4|These new clothes are nice.|这些新衣服很好看。|go shopping=去购物;how much=多少钱|I go shopping with Mum. I try on a blue shirt. It is just right, so we buy it.|我和妈妈去购物。我试穿一件蓝色衬衫。它很合身，所以我们买下了它。

4-lower-5|I have a lot of animals.|我有许多动物。|on the farm=在农场里;a lot of=许多|There are cows and sheep on the farm. The farmer grows vegetables too. We learn where our food comes from.|农场里有奶牛和绵羊。农民还种蔬菜。我们了解了食物从哪里来。

4-lower-6|I can use chopsticks.|我会用筷子。|work hard=努力工作;from farm to table=从农场到餐桌|Farmers grow rice in the fields. Workers take it to shops. We cook it for dinner and try not to waste food.|农民在田里种稻子。工人把大米运到商店。我们把它做成晚饭，并努力不浪费食物。

5-upper-1|I have a friend. It's a girl.|我有一个朋友。她是个女孩。|different hobbies=不同的爱好;be kind to=友善地对待|My friends have different hobbies. Ben enjoys running, while Lily likes painting. We learn new things from one another.|我的朋友们有不同的爱好。本喜欢跑步，莉莉喜欢画画。我们互相学习新东西。

5-upper-2|You look sad. What's the matter？|你看起来很难过。怎么了？|feel worried=感到担心;talk to a friend=和朋友聊一聊|I feel nervous before a test. I take a deep breath and talk to my teacher. Then I feel ready to try.|考试前我感到紧张。我深呼吸并和老师聊一聊。然后我觉得自己准备好去尝试了。

5-upper-3|I often cook lunch for my family.|我经常为家人做午饭。|on Wednesday=在星期三;after school=放学后|I make a plan for each day. I finish my homework after school. Then I play outside and have time to rest.|我为每天制定计划。放学后我完成作业。然后我到户外玩，并留出休息时间。

5-upper-4|We wash our hands with soap.|我们用肥皂洗手。|healthy habits=健康习惯;go to bed=上床睡觉|I want to build healthy habits. I wash my hands before eating and exercise every day. I also go to bed early.|我想养成健康的习惯。我饭前洗手，每天锻炼。我也早早上床睡觉。

5-upper-5|We eat this part of a carrot.|我们吃胡萝卜的这一部分。|a balanced meal=均衡的一餐;come from=来自|We eat different parts of plants. Carrots are roots, and apples are fruit. A balanced meal gives us energy.|我们吃植物的不同部位。胡萝卜是根，苹果是果实。均衡的一餐给我们提供能量。

5-upper-6|There is a big forest in the park.|公园里有一大片森林。|protect nature=保护自然;in the forest=在森林里|We visited a forest on Saturday. We saw birds and tall trees. We took our rubbish home to keep the forest clean.|星期六我们去了森林。我们看到了鸟和高大的树。我们把垃圾带回家，以保持森林清洁。

5-lower-1|I usually wash my clothes.|我通常洗自己的衣服。|do morning exercises=做早操;eat breakfast=吃早饭|I usually get up at seven on weekdays. After breakfast, I walk to school. On weekends, I help my parents at home.|工作日我通常七点起床。早饭后我步行去学校。周末我在家帮助父母。

5-lower-2|I can play in the snow.|我可以在雪里玩。|go on a picnic=去野餐;my favourite season=我最喜欢的季节|Spring is my favourite season. The weather is warm and flowers open. My family often goes on a picnic by the river.|春天是我最喜欢的季节。天气暖和，花儿开放。我家人经常去河边野餐。

5-lower-3|You will meet Robin the Robot.|你将见到机器人罗宾。|sports meet=运动会;school calendar=校历|Our school has a sports meet in April. We will run and play games. I am practising with my friends after school.|我们学校四月有运动会。我们会跑步、做游戏。放学后我正在和朋友们一起练习。

5-lower-4|The show is very funny！|这场表演很有趣！|on the first day=在第一天;birthday party=生日聚会|My birthday is on May fifth. I will invite my friends to my home. We will make a fruit cake together.|我的生日是五月五日。我会邀请朋友们来家里。我们会一起做一个水果蛋糕。

5-lower-5|The carrots are theirs.|这些胡萝卜是他们的。|whose book=谁的书;play with the dog=和狗玩|This blue pencil is mine, and the red one is yours. The books on the desk are ours. Let's put everything away.|这支蓝色铅笔是我的，红色那支是你的。桌子上的书是我们的。我们把所有东西收好吧。

5-lower-6|The red one is yours.|红色的那个是你的。|take turns=轮流;work quietly=安静地做事|We are working in the library. Some children are reading, and others are writing. We speak quietly and take turns using the books.|我们正在图书馆学习。有些孩子在读书，另一些在写字。我们轻声说话，轮流使用图书。

6-upper-1|I watched the sunrise.|我观看了日出。|climb a mountain=爬山;watch the sunrise=看日出|Last summer, we visited a mountain town. We climbed a hill and watched the sunrise. I wrote about the trip in my diary.|去年夏天，我们去了一个山城。我们爬上山丘看日出。我把这次旅行写进了日记。

6-upper-2|We are all afraid of it.|我们都害怕它。|get together=相聚;celebrate a festival=庆祝节日|Our family gets together for the Spring Festival. We cook dinner and share stories. Being together is the best part of the holiday.|春节时我们一家人团聚。我们做晚饭、讲故事。相聚是节日里最美好的部分。

6-upper-3|You should drink some water and have a rest.|你应该喝些水，休息一下。|have a rest=休息一下;have a cold=感冒|To stay healthy, I try to eat well and sleep enough. When I feel tired, I take a rest. I also talk to my family when I feel worried.|为了保持健康，我尽量吃得好、睡得足。感到疲倦时我会休息。担心时我也会和家人聊一聊。

6-upper-4|We use money to buy goods.|我们用钱购买商品。|save money=存钱;make a shopping list=列购物清单|I make a shopping list before visiting a shop. I compare prices and buy only what I need. I save some pocket money for a book.|去商店前我会列购物清单。我比较价格，只买需要的东西。我存下一些零花钱买书。

6-upper-5|We explore space in different ways.|我们用不同的方式探索太空。|explore space=探索太空;around the Sun=围绕太阳|The Earth travels around the Sun. People use telescopes and spacecraft to learn about space. I hope to learn more about the stars.|地球绕着太阳运行。人们用望远镜和航天器了解太空。我希望学到更多有关星星的知识。

6-upper-6|This will save more energy and resources.|这会节省更多能源和资源。|save energy=节约能源;turn off the lights=关灯|We can save energy in everyday life. I turn off the lights when I leave a room. I walk to nearby places instead of taking a car.|我们可以在日常生活中节约能源。离开房间时我会关灯。去附近的地方时，我步行而不坐汽车。

6-lower-1|How tall are you？|你有多高？|taller than=比……更高;how heavy=多重|My brother is taller than me, but I can run faster. We measured our heights yesterday. We are both growing every year.|我哥哥比我高，但我跑得更快。昨天我们测量了身高。我们每年都在长大。

6-lower-2|I watched some children's shows on TV.|我在电视上看了一些儿童节目。|last weekend=上周末;stay at home=待在家里|Last weekend, I stayed at home in the morning. I cleaned my room and read a story. In the afternoon, I played football with my friends.|上周末上午我待在家里。我打扫房间，读了一个故事。下午我和朋友们踢了足球。

6-lower-3|We bought some gifts and ate some delicious food.|我们买了一些礼物，吃了一些美味的食物。|take pictures=拍照;go camping=去露营|We went to a lake during the holiday. We took pictures and rode our bikes. I bought a small gift for my grandmother.|假期里我们去了一个湖边。我们拍照、骑自行车。我给奶奶买了一件小礼物。

6-lower-4|The school changed a little.|学校发生了一些变化。|years ago=多年前;then and now=过去和现在|Our school is different now. There was no library ten years ago, but there is a large one today. We can read many books there.|我们的学校现在不一样了。十年前没有图书馆，但如今有了一座大图书馆。我们可以在那里读许多书。
